description: End-to-end loop cases. Each is a draft plus what a human did to it, and what the pipeline must then do: classify the verdict, derive the family from the chip, compute the diff, and route the result to the voice corpus or the defect list. pct_changed and n_edits are FROZEN outputs of diff_ops — if they move, the metric changed, and every number derived from it changed with it.
